wb.ex.title: Files
wb.ex.openFolderHelp: The full path of a project folder on this machine. It becomes a project root: the workbench may read and write it, the crew and peers may not.
wb.ex.deleteDirCount: It holds {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} and {folders, plural, one {# folder} other {# folders}}. All of them are deleted.
wb.ex.deleteNote: It does not go to a recycle bin. A file under git can come back with a discard in source control.
wb.ex.removeRootText: Remove {name} from the workbench? The folder and its files stay on disk.
wb.ex.inRoot: At the top of the root. A path like src/app.js creates the folders too.
wb.ex.otherRoot: Files can only move inside their own root
wb.ex.nameSlash: A name cannot have a slash
wb.ex.nameAbsolute: Use a path inside the root, not a full path
wb.ex.nameBad: "{name}" is not a valid file name
wb.ed.approval: Waiting for the host to approve
wb.ed.trim: Trim trailing spaces and end with one newline
wb.ed.toReview: Changed by the crew, not reviewed yet
wb.ed.diskChanged: {who} changed this file while you have unsaved edits.
wb.ed.diskChangedOutside: This file changed on disk while you have unsaved edits.
wb.ed.unsaved: Save the changes to {name} before closing?
wb.ed.binary: This is a binary file; the editor shows text only.
wb.ed.tooLarge: This file is larger than 2 MB ({size} MB) and opens only outside the workbench.
wb.se.include: Files to include, for example src/**, *.js

wb.se.timedOut: Stopped: the search took too long
wb.se.skipped: {n, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} over 2 MB skipped
wb.se.previewSum: {n, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}} in {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}; uncheck the files to leave alone
wb.se.apply: Replace {n} in {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}

wb.se.applied: Replaced {n} in {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}
wb.scm.commitN: Commit {n, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}

wb.scm.committed: Committed {sha} ({n, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}) on {branch}
wb.scm.stageAllText: Stage all {n, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}} and commit them?

wb.scm.discardMany: Put {n} files back the way they are in the index? Your edits to them are lost.
wb.scm.clean: No changes since the last commit
wb.scm.notRepo: This folder is not a git repository yet.
wb.scm.initText: Run git init here, on the branch main? Nothing is committed or pushed.
wb.scm.gitMissing: git is not installed or not on the PATH. Install git, then restart hivedesk.
wb.scm.conflicts: {n, plural, one {# file has} other {# files have}} merge conflicts; fix them in the editor, then stage
wb.scm.truncated: Only the first 5,000 changed files are listed
wb.scm.branchName: Name of the new branch (you switch to it)
wb.scm.badBranch: Use letters, digits, dots, dashes, underscores and slashes
wb.out.empty: Output of the crew's runs shows here.
wb.pr.title: Problems
wb.pr.none: No problems found in the open and project files
wb.pr.loading: Reading the project for problems: {n} files
wb.pr.project: Project wide for {n, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}
wb.pr.projectCapped: Project wide for the first {n} files (capped)

wb.term.share: Share this terminal with a peer
wb.term.shareOff: Sharing needs a peer connected through the City
wb.term.noPeers: No known peer to share with yet
wb.term.basicTip: A basic terminal over pipes, without a TTY: full screen programs and colors may not work. {reason}
wb.term.basicBanner: Basic terminal (no TTY): type a command and press Enter. {reason}
wb.term.minutesLeft: {n, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} left
wb.term.shareText: {name} runs with your rights on this machine. Share it only with someone you trust.
wb.term.modeReadTip: They see what the terminal prints
wb.term.modeWriteTip: They can run any command as you
wb.term.shareAudit: The start, the stop and the byte count of what they type go to the audit log, never the text.
wb.settings.title: Settings
wb.set.where: Saved in the workbench section of settings.json in the hivedesk folder.
wb.set.stickyHelp: Keep the enclosing function and class at the top
wb.set.formatOnSaveHelp: HTML, CSS, JSON, JavaScript and TypeScript are formatted; other files get their trailing spaces trimmed
wb.set.themeHelp: Follow the desktop theme, also themes you made in the Theme editor
wb.set.projectHelp: Read up to 2,000 JavaScript and TypeScript files so problems, go to definition and symbols cover the whole project
wb.set.excludesHelp: One glob per line, for example dist/** or *.min.js. .git, node_modules and .gitignore are always honored.
wb.set.shellHelp: Leave empty for your default shell
wb.set.shellBasic: Runs as a basic terminal here: {reason}
wb.set.rootsHelp: Folders the workbench may read and write. The crew and peers stay in the workspace.
